label: TP
reason: Single alert java/xss is TRUE POSITIVE. User input from request.getParameter flows through param.replace("\"", """) to bar, then directly into HTML attribute data-name="'" + bar + "'". While double quotes are escaped to ", single quotes remain unescaped. Attacker input containing single quotes (like \'><script>) can break out of the single-quote-delimited attribute and execute arbitrary JavaScript in the DOM.

evidence.note: User input param flows to bar via replace(), then bar is concatenated into HTML attribute without single-quote escaping, creating XSS vulnerability
